card.name: Storage time limits before discarding
card.fires_on: The spot just before a number of hours or days in storage and discard instructions for prepared or diluted solutions. It also fires on 'temperature' or 'for' when a time limit follows.

modes.label: Space before hours
modes.description: The blank position after 'after' or 'than' just before a number of hours in a hold-time limit.
modes.example: Discard unused diluted solution after<< >>18 hours at room temperature or

modes.label: Words before a time limit
modes.description: 'temperature' or 'for' right before a duration such as 48 hours or 1 hour.
modes.example: Discard any product left at room<< temperature>> for greater than 48 hours.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about redundancy or discarding and away from words about death and danger, so little clear effect on the next word.
card.plain: It lights up where a label is about to say how long a prepared drug can be kept before it must be thrown away.
